methods.name: Add
methods.description: Store a user-supplied 32-bit value XYZ in the next free pool slot and return the slot index N in DR0. N is the retrieval key for Constants.Get(N). Returns FAULT if the pool (14 slots) is full.
inputs: DR0: XYZ — any IEEE-754 or raw 32-bit value to store
outputs: DR0: N — pool slot index (0–13); FAULT if pool is full
comments: bindMethod scans the bitmap, places XYZ in pool memory, marks slot as occupied
returns slot index N in DR0 — no GT is created, no NS entry is written
the pool is internal to the Constants abstraction boundary

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Read back the 32-bit value stored by Constants.Add() at slot index N. N comes from DR0. Returns FAULT if N is out of range or the slot is not allocated.
inputs: DR0: N — pool slot index returned by a prior Constants.Add()
outputs: DR0: stored 32-bit value; FAULT if N invalid or unallocated
comments: bindMethod validates N against POOL_SIZE and the bitmap
reads pool memory at poolBase + N and returns the value in DR0
no NS lookup — the pool is internal to the Constants abstraction

methods.name: Add

methods.name: IsHex

methods.name: Offset

methods.name: StringOp

methods.name: CheckNonZero

methods.name: CheckPositive
methods.description: Return DR0 if DR0 > 0, else FAULT. Guards operations requiring a strictly positive value.
outputs: DR0: DR0 (pass-through if positive), FAULT otherwise

methods.name: ComputeBase

methods.name: Classify

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Send the call-home identification packet and await ACK from the IDE bridge. Replaces the hardwired B:02½ boot step. Writes 3 words to UART TX: [boot_reason · last_fault · fault_NIA], then blocks on RX for IDE ACK. Offline-safe: DR0 ≤ 0 if no ACK.
outputs: DR0: 1 = IDE connected and ACK received | ≤0 = offline
comments: LOAD  AL, CR7, CR6[0]   ; UART GT from c-list slot 0 → CR7
DWRITE DR1, CR7[0]       ; TX: boot_reason
DWRITE DR2, CR7[0]       ; TX: last_fault
DWRITE DR3, CR7[0]       ; TX: fault_NIA
DREAD  DR0, CR7[1]       ; RX: IDE ACK (1=connected, ≤0=offline)
RETURN AL, CR5

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Transmit a self-identifying FourCC media packet to the IDE. Writes 3 words to UART TX: [tag · count · payload]. Tag is open registry—TEXT/VOIC/LUMP/GTKN/JPEG/PDF_/MP3_/… Fire-and-forget.
comments: LOAD  AL, CR7, CR6[0]   ; UART GT → CR7
DWRITE DR1, CR7[0]       ; TX: FourCC tag word
DWRITE DR2, CR7[0]       ; TX: payload word count
DWRITE DR3, CR7[0]       ; TX: first payload word
DREAD  DR0, CR7[0]       ; TX queue status → DR0 (0=OK, 1=overrun)
RETURN AL, CR5

methods.name: Receive
methods.description: Block until the IDE sends a self-identifying media packet or timeout expires. Three consecutive DREAD instructions read the next three words from UART RX into DR0, DR1, DR2. All three are visible to the caller after RETURN.
inputs: DR1: timeout in CPU steps (0 = wait forever)
outputs: DR1: FourCC type tag (TEXT · VOIC · LUMP · GTKN · …)
comments: LOAD  AL, CR7, CR6[0]   ; UART GT → CR7
DWRITE DR1, CR7[0]       ; TX: timeout hint
DREAD  DR0, CR7[1]       ; RX word 0 → DR0 (word count; 0=timeout)
DREAD  DR1, CR7[1]       ; RX word 1 → DR1 (FourCC tag)
DREAD  DR2, CR7[1]       ; RX word 2 → DR2 (first payload word)
RETURN AL, CR5

methods.name: Fault
methods.description: Report a hardware fault with full semantic location to the IDE. High-priority: bypasses the normal send queue. Writes 6 words to UART TX: [fault_code · ns_idx · thread_gt · abstr_idx · method_idx · instr_offset].
inputs: DR3: thread_gt — NS index of the faulting thread
DR4: abstr_idx — NS slot of the executing abstraction
DR5: method_idx — method index within the abstraction
DR6: instr_offset — instruction offset within the method
comments: LOAD  AL, CR7, CR6[0]   ; UART GT → CR7
DWRITE DR1, CR7[0]       ; TX: fault_code
DWRITE DR2, CR7[0]       ; TX: ns_idx
DWRITE DR3, CR7[0]       ; TX: thread_gt
DWRITE DR4, CR7[0]       ; TX: abstr_idx
DWRITE DR5, CR7[0]       ; TX: method_idx
DWRITE DR6, CR7[0]       ; TX: instr_offset
DREAD  DR0, CR7[0]       ; TX queue status → DR0 (0=OK)
RETURN AL, CR5

methods.name: Fetch
methods.description: Request and receive a lump binary from the IDE by NS slot token. Writes 2 words to UART TX: [token · expected_words]. IDE streams the lump back; hardware writes it via CR2. Called by Loader on NULL_CAP fault for a cold slot.
inputs: DR1: NS slot token (identifies the requested abstraction)
DR2: expected lump size in words
comments: LOAD  AL, CR7, CR6[0]   ; UART GT → CR7
DWRITE DR1, CR7[0]       ; TX: slot token request
DWRITE DR2, CR7[0]       ; TX: expected word count
DREAD  DR0, CR7[1]       ; RX: 0=installed, non-zero=error
RETURN AL, CR5

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Forward a CALL through the tunnel to a remote capability. The ‘Hello Mum’ primitive: CALL(CONNECT(me, mymother)). Restricts remote_gt to E-only, invokes via CALL, then reads the far-end return value from UART RX.
inputs: CR2: remote GT (Outform type, F-bit set — far-end abstraction)
outputs: DR0: far-end return value | non-zero = error / timeout
comments: LOAD  AL, CR7, CR6[0]   ; UART GT → CR7
TPERM AL, CR2, #E        ; restrict remote_gt to E-only before CALL
CALL  AL, CR2, CR2       ; invoke remote_gt via tunnel
DREAD  DR0, CR7[1]       ; RX: far-end return value → DR0
RETURN AL, CR5

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Verify Mum's 32-bit identity word. Zero or unknown protocol tag (bits[31:28] != 1) returns 0 (AM rejected). Valid identity returns 1; the simulator issues an Outform E-GT into c-list slot 1.
inputs: DR1: mum_identity_word — 32-bit encoded Mum public key reference (Ed25519 fingerprint; see Mum.cloomc)
outputs: DR0: 1 (identity accepted; GT stored in c-list slot 1) | 0 (AM rejected)
comments: if mum_identity_word == 0: return 0 (AM rejected)
version = mum_identity_word >> 28
if version != 1: return 0 (unknown protocol tag)
return 1 (identity accepted; system abstraction issues GT)

methods.name: Hello
methods.description: Load c-list slot 1 (Mum E-GT) and forward a CALL through the Tunnel to the far-end Mum.Greet() method. Returns FAULT_NO_CONTACT (0xDEAD0001) if Connect has not been called.
outputs: DR0: 0x48454C4C (far-end greeting word 'HELL' — Mum responded normally)
DR0: 0xDEAD0001 (FAULT_NO_CONTACT — c-list slot 1 is NULL, Connect not yet called)
DR0: non-zero Tunnel error on transmission failure
comments: Load c-list slot 1 into CR7 — the Mum E-GT (NULL at boot)
Test CR7 for NULL GT (word == 0); if NULL branch to FAULT_NO_CONTACT return
FAULT_NO_CONTACT = 0xDEAD0001 — clean fault, not a crash
Load Tunnel GT from c-list slot 0 into CR8
Tunnel.Connect(mum_gt) — forward CALL via GTKN packet to far-end Mum.Greet()
Receive far-end return value; return it as DR0

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Arm the transmitter after pre-loading frame bytes into ETH_TX_DATA (offset 6). DR1 = dataGT (reserved for future DMA path, ignored in MMIO model); DR2 = byte count. Returns DR1 = byteLen.
inputs: DR1: dataGT — reserved for future DMA path; ignored in MMIO model
DR2: byteLen — byte count of frame pre-loaded in TX FIFO (1-1518)

methods.name: Receive
methods.description: Poll for a pending frame (non-blocking). Returns DR1 = 0 if no frame waiting, or DR1 = N (byte count) when a frame is ready. Drain via N sequential ETH_RX_DATA reads.
outputs: DR1: 0 = no frame waiting; N = byte count of pending frame
